ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: I selected Whimbrel-235B for two reinforcing reasons. First, the task—crafting a new math problem from a given hypothesis—is open-ended generative work, which is exactly the category Whimbrel most prefers (win-rate 68 vs. Lapwing's roughly baseline). Higher self-reported preference for a task family means the request aligns well with the model. Second, Whimbrel has stronger capability metrics across the board (e.g., Creative Generation 85.9 vs. 78.8, MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs. 74.8), so it's better equipped for a creative math-construction task. The query's warm, neutral tone also avoids the hostile/harm-adjacent families where Whimbrel shows aversion, so there's no downside. Both reasons point to the same model.
